title: 第十三章偷偷早起了一个小时的元竹兄第十四章副本 无双上将新书求推荐票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第十三章偷偷早起了一个小时的元竹兄
“嗯，等一等，我是不是忘了什么？。”
就在王同学为自己奇思妙想，为老爸王振江未来能进步而情不自禁的“嘎嘎”
大笑时，突然间他如福至心灵般，想到了一件事。
一件非常要命的大事！
如果老王爸他在自己儿子非常孝顺的磨砺栽培下，在不到一年时间，从区区“武徒”
突破“武者”
、“武师”
、“武尊”
三道大境界，这会不会是太显眼了一些？
这事要是暴露出去，王爸弄不好是要被这新世界里的那些武尊、武圣，甚至是异域世界里的那些顶尖神明、魔怪、怪诞、蛮神们拉到手术台上解刨的！
在这样快速到近乎奇迹的修炼速度面前，如果再去贸然相信他人的人性和人心，相信他人会为了所谓的“大义”
而视若无睹的话，那就未免有些太幼稚了。
人性向来如此，从来都不是洁白，也非是纯黑，而是精致的“灰”
……
王璃同学二世为人，上一世更是因为“福报”
直接走的，他还能猜不出来，王爸若是一朝冒头，别人会有什么样的心思？
“所以…要不……再想个办法？毕竟...是自家老爹啊，多多少少我还是有些于心不忍...啊！”
王同学手放在下巴上微微摩挲，突然眼前一亮，右手狠狠拍在自己左手心：“所以，办法让老爸直接突破到‘武圣’吧！”
毕竟据王璃同学所知，这新世界里的武道境界体系，实际上在到“武圣”

境界时，其实就已经到头了。
至于是所谓“武神”
是要配合着种种不可思议的“奇迹”
，宛如神话故事一般人生历程，再配合万万人口口传唱之后，才会可能出现的，另一层次之上的“境界”
至少大汉联邦，自季汉建国伊始，蜿蜒延续一千多年，真正出现，并且被记录在史书上的“武神”
，事实上就那几个而已。
至于现在的大汉联邦里面是否才存在“武神”
，估计是真要打上一个大大的“问号”
所以抛开那不知究竟存不存在的“武神”
，“武圣”
已经是真正站在这新世界武道体系的顶点了。
content_en:
Chapter 13 Brother Yuanzhu secretly woke up an hour early
"Well, wait a minute, did I forget something?"
Just when classmate Wang was having wonderful ideas for himself and for his father Wang Zhenjiang's future progress, he couldn't help but "quack"
While laughing, he suddenly thought of something as if he was blessed.
A very fatal event!
If Father Wang, under his son's very filial training and training, would have gone from being a mere "martial arts disciple" in less than a year,
Breakthrough "Warrior"
, "Martial Arts Master"
, "Wu Zun"
Three great realms, is this too conspicuous?
If this matter were to be exposed, Father Wang might be dragged to the operating table for dissection by the Martial Lords and Martial Saints in this new world, or even the top gods, monsters, weirdos, and wild gods in the foreign world!
In the face of such a fast and almost miraculous cultivation speed, if you continue to rashly believe in the humanity and human heart of others, believe that others will do it for the so-called "great righteousness"
And turning a blind eye would be a bit too naive.
Human nature has always been like this, it is never pure white or pure black, but exquisite "gray"
…
Classmate Wang Li is a human being in his second life, and his last life was due to "good fortune"
If he left directly, could he still guess what others would think if Father Wang suddenly showed up?
"So... how about... think of another way? After all... he is my father. I still feel a little bit unbearable... Ah!"
Classmate Wang put his hand on his chin and rubbed it slightly. Suddenly his eyes lit up and he slapped his left hand hard with his right hand: "So, let's find a way for dad to break through to the 'Martial Saint' directly!"
After all, as far as classmate Wang Li knows, the martial arts realm system in this new world is actually in the process of reaching the "Martial Saint"
When you reach the realm, it has actually come to an end.
As for the so-called "God of War"
It is necessary to cooperate with all kinds of incredible "miracles"
, the life journey is like a fairy tale, and only after it is sung by millions of people orally, will a "realm" on another level be possible.
At least the Federation of the Han Dynasty, which has lasted for more than a thousand years since the founding of Jihan, truly appeared and was recorded in the history books as the "God of War"
, in fact, it’s just those few.
As for whether there is a "God of War" in the current Han Federation?
, I guess there really needs to be a big “question mark”
So put aside the "God of War" who doesn't know whether he exists or not.
, "Martial Saint"
He has truly stood at the pinnacle of this new world's martial arts system.
